answers.actors: Maintainer: approve specs, run gates, review evidence
answers.outcomes: The close-harness-gaps feature has approved semantic contracts, strict command-backed TDD records, completed task groups, validation summaries, deep review, semantic verification, review decisions, changelog, roadmap evidence, and completion telemetry.
answers.entities: Feature Spec; Semantic Contract; TDD Evidence; Task Group Progress; Validation Summary; Review Summary; Review Decision; Roadmap Update; Waiver
answers.commands: questions capture; feature semantics; feature validate-spec; feature approve; feature plan-tdd; feature implement; feature record-tdd; feature complete-task-group; feature run-validation; feature deep-review; feature semantic-verify; feature review-decisions; changelog update; feature complete

answers.invariants: No implementation/task-group completion without current feature approval; Strict task groups require red and green command-backed TDD records; Validation must run after task evidence before completion; Review, semantic verification, review decisions, changelog, and roadmap evidence must exist before completion; Local adapters must stay outside domain/application logic
answers.scenarios: Complete dogfood evidence: capture questions -> generate semantic contract -> approve current hashes -> record strict TDD -> complete task groups -> run validation -> complete feature; Verify readiness: add local configs -> run strict doctor -> confirm every readiness check passes
answers.oracles: workflow doctor --strict passes; feature validation commands pass; semantic verification passes without blocking findings; feature complete succeeds only after task, validation, review, semantic, decision, changelog, and roadmap evidence
answers.telemetry: feature complete-task-group; feature run-validation; feature deep-review; feature semantic-verify; feature review-decisions; changelog update; feature complete
